nodes.norm_label: guia d'edicio de la web (website editing guide)
nodes.rationale: Site is built as plain static files with no build step so non-technical staff can edit in any text editor and re-upload to Hostinger. Frequently-changed content is centralised in lib/manifest.js; reserve copy also lives in each .html in case JavaScript does not run. The ?v=YYYYMMDD cache-busting param must be bumped on every upload so visitors get the fresh CSS/JS. equip.html is kept as a redirect to nosaltres.html#equip to avoid breaking old links. Editors must never invent data (col·legiacions, testimonials) and should leave "[PENDENT]" placeholders.

nodes.label: Avís legal (Legal Notice)
nodes.community_name: Guia d'edició de la web (Website Editing Guide)
nodes.rationale: Structural template only; must be completed and validated with legal counsel before publishing the site. Site content is stated to be general information that does not replace individual professional assessment.

nodes.label: Política de cookies (Cookie Policy)
nodes.community_name: Guia d'edició de la web (Website Editing Guide)
nodes.rationale: The site is static and by design sets no own tracking or analytics cookies; the only external connection is Google Fonts, with a pending action to self-host fonts to remove it. Any future analytics would require a prior consent banner and an update to this page.

nodes.label: Política de privadesa (Privacy Policy)
nodes.community_name: Guia d'edició de la web (Website Editing Guide)
nodes.rationale: Structural template adapted to RGPD and LOPDGDD; needs legal validation especially for special-category health-data processing. The contact form is deliberately not used as a diagnostic tool and collects only data needed to answer the request.
